text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished running the Kikuka-sho, 
Marvelous Sunday is thrilled by the sheer 
joy of a race where rivals clash soul 
against soul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her positivity remained steadfast even on 
the grand stage, and that feeling seemed 
to reach the audience as well. At this 
rate, the upcoming Challenge Cup is in 
safe hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Smooth sailing, feeling confident—or 
so it seemed. Up until this very moment, 
that is...
